licenses.text:
Young's Literal Translation, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/engylt/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this
translation):
> "Young's Literal Translation
Young's Literal Translation of the Holy Bible
Public Domain
Language: ENGLISH (English)
Dialect: archaic British
Translation by: Robert Young

This public domain Bible translation is brought to you courtesy of eBible.org.
If you would like to make a donation to help keep free Bible access like this going, please visit https://eBible.org/give.php."

Why this is public domain:
First published in 1862 in the United Kingdom (revised edition 1898). Robert Young died in 1887 (Wikipedia), so the work is public domain in the United Kingdom (its country of origin) and in the United States.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain
text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source),
and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page
(https://ebible.org/details.php?id=engylt) and the edition's own files.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)
